verdict.text: Morocco pledges a 17% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (unconditional), and 42% conditional. The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-09-30. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (archived) (2016). The document's condition, in its own words: "Conditional Target An additional reduction of 25 % achievable under certain conditions, which would bring the total GHG reduction to 42 % below BAU emission levels by 2030, including AFOLU actions." 54 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (8). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 116.8 MtCO₂e, DS-35 101.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 17% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 47.7 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 17% (unconditional) to 42% (conditional) reduction in GHG emission by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario, taking into account reductions in Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.51°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.24°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
